entries.hook: A {2|person} asleep in the {3|evening}, {0|eyebrows} over an {1|eye} that still sees things: a **dream**.

more.text: The top is written like 艹 grass today, but it was drawn as eyebrows.
The oldest drawing also showed a bed. It was dropped long ago.

entries.hook: Words cut into {0|metal} so they last: **to record**.

more.text: Words cut into metal is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Silk threads} cut through by an {1|axe}: **to break off**.
A {0|measuring hand} pointing out the {1|way, 道 dào}: **to guide**.
entries.plain: A hand pointing out where to go: to guide.

more.text: 道 dào, the way, gives the meaning and the sound.

entries.hook: A drawing of an animal's {0|horn}: a **horn**.

more.text: It also means a corner. In 角色 it is a part in a play: a role.

entries.hook: A {1|crowd} of people at work under the {0|sun}: a **crowd**.

more.text: The top was first the sun. Later it came to be drawn like an eye.

entries.hook: {1|Flesh} holding fast to the {0|bare bone}, a firm yes: **to agree**.

more.text: The drawing meant meat on a bone. "To agree" only borrowed its sound, so the firm yes is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|hand} poking at someone to start something: **to provoke**.
One {1|single, 單 dān} {0|weapon} against another: a **battle**.
entries.plain: Weapon against weapon: a battle.

more.text: 單 dān, single, gives the sound. Single combat is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A sound from the {0|mouth} that says yes without a word: **mm-hm**.
A long breath out of the {0|mouth} when things go wrong: **oh dear**.
The {0|heart} holding steady while it hurts: **to bear**.
A {1|measuring hand} that keeps going, on {0|and} on: **to hold out**.

more.text: The Shuowen dictionary lists 而 ér as a piece of this character. 而 drew a beard and now means "and", so "on and on" is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: You keep {0|going} after your hat as the wind blows it down the street: **to chase**.

more.text: Running after the flying hat is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Water} at its {1|origin, 原 yuán}: a **source**.
entries.plain: Where the water first comes out: a source.

more.text: 原 yuán, origin, gives the meaning and the sound.

entries.hook: A {0|flame} on its {1|lamp stand}, the one light everyone gathers round: the **master**.

more.text: The drawing is a lamp with its flame, now written 炷. "Master" only borrowed its sound, so gathering round the light is only a memory trick.
The classic dictionary names the two parts: the flame and the lamp.

entries.hook: A {1|good, 良 liáng} {0|moon}, full and clear: **bright**.
entries.plain: A full, clear moon: bright.

more.text: 良 liáng, good, gives the sound. The good moon is only a memory trick.
In 開朗 it is a bright, open nature: cheerful.

entries.hook: {0|Going} the way that fits you: **to suit**.
A shape carved in {0|tree} wood for others to copy: a **model**.
The right drink from the {0|wine jar} to go with the food: **to match**.

more.text: References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.

entries.hook: A {0|hand} lifting it by the handle: **to carry**.
A {0|hand} pushing it up straight, above the rest: **very**.

more.text: Pushing it up above the rest is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: With the {0|head} bowed, taking what the {1|order, 令 lìng} says is yours: **to receive**.
entries.plain: Stepping up to take what is yours: to receive.

more.text: 令 lìng, an order, gives the sound. The order is only a memory trick.
It also means the neck, a collar and to lead.

entries.hook: A {0|person} bringing things for all to {1|share, 共 gòng}: **to provide**.
entries.plain: A person bringing what others need: to provide.

more.text: 共 gòng, shared, gives the sound. Sharing is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: By {0|decree}, everything put {1|straight, 正 zhèng}, nothing missing: **whole**.
entries.plain: Everything in order, nothing missing: whole.

more.text: 正 zhèng, straight or correct, gives the sound. Putting things straight is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Noodles {1|wrapped, 包 bāo} in hot {0|water} until soft: **to soak**.
entries.plain: Left in hot water until soft: to soak.

more.text: 包 bāo, to wrap, gives the sound. The wrapping is only a memory trick.
It also means a bubble.

entries.hook: A {0|person} with a job to do and something in the {2|right hand}: **to use**.

more.text: Nobody knows what the hand is holding.
Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

entries.hook: Soft white {0|food}, steamed until it swells: a **steamed bun**.
{0|Plants} grown to be eaten: **greens**.
A purse open as wide as a {1|yawn}, waiting to be filled: **funds**.
entries.plain: A sum of money set aside: funds.

more.text: 欠 gives the meaning: to lack, to want. The left side is an old sound piece.
The open purse is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|person} catches every falling plate without breaking one: **excellent**.

more.text: Catching every falling plate is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A drawing of an open {0|umbrella}: an **umbrella**.
A {1|cask of wine} kept under a {0|cliff} until the taste is deep and rich: **thick**.

more.text: It first described a strong, rich taste.

entries.hook: A {1|hand with a spear}, here a hammer, breaking {0|stone} into pieces: a **section**.

more.text: The drawing meant to forge, now written 鍛. "Section" only borrowed its sound, so breaking the stone into pieces is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: What {1|must, 必 bì} stay at the {0|altar} and not be told: **secret**.
entries.plain: What stays at the altar and is not told: secret.

more.text: 必 bì, must, gives the sound. "Must stay" is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: The {0|grain} store nobody {1|must, 必 bì} know about: **secret**.
entries.plain: A hidden store of grain: secret.

more.text: 必 bì, must, gives the sound. The hidden grain is only a memory trick.
It is another way to write 祕.

entries.hook: A {1|flat, 平 píng} piece of {0|earth}, measured out: a **ping**.
entries.plain: A piece of ground, measured out: a ping.

more.text: 平 píng, flat, gives the sound. The flat ground is only a memory trick.
One ping is about 3.3 square metres of floor.

entries.hook: Two {0|stones} {1|side by side, 並 bìng} knocking together: **to bump into**.
entries.plain: Stone knocking against stone: to bump into.

more.text: 並 bìng, side by side, gives the sound. Stones side by side are only a memory trick.

entries.hook: How the {0|heart} shows on the outside: **manner**.
A {0|trap in the ground} waiting for whoever steps in: **fierce**.

pieces.name: kneeling person
pieces.note: now looks like 儿 walking legs

entries.hook: {0|Bad luck, 凶 xiōng}, with a {1|kneeling person} added: a person who is **fierce**.
entries.plain: Danger in the shape of a person: fierce.

more.text: 凶 xiōng is the older way to write this word. It gives the meaning and the sound.

entries.hook: What a thing is really made of: its **quality**.

more.text: Nobody is sure how this character began.

entries.hook: {0|Going} with everything {1|bound, 束 shù} tight and nothing to slow you: **fast**.
entries.plain: Going with nothing to slow you: fast.

more.text: 束 shù, to bind, gives the sound. Binding things tight is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|clay pot} with a piece broken off the rim: **lacking**.
Coming away with a {1|loss}: **to lose out**.
{0|Water} you cannot see the bottom of: **deep**.

more.text: Of a colour it means dark.

entries.hook: {0|Water} that only reaches your ankles: **shallow**.

more.text: Of a colour it means light.

entries.hook: A {0|person} in a shirt matching yours takes your hand for the walk home: a **companion**.

more.text: The matching shirts is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|stone} that tears the {1|skin, 皮}: **to break**.

more.text: 皮 pí, skin, was the sound long ago. The torn skin is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|hand} sends an empty wrapper flying into the bin: **to throw away**.

more.text: Throwing the wrapper into a bin is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: The outside layer of the {1|flesh}: **skin**.

more.text: Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

pieces.name: shoulder shape
pieces.note: now looks like 戶 house door

entries.hook: A {0|shoulder shape} above the {1|flesh} of the arm: the **shoulder**.
The {0|flesh} at each {1|side, 旁 páng} of the body, where the arm begins: the **upper arm**.
entries.plain: The flesh where the arm begins: the upper arm.

more.text: 旁 páng, side, gives the sound. The side of the body is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: You slide a {0|shell} across the counter, and the seller hands you a bun: **to buy**.

more.text: Buying a bun with a shell is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Just one {0|person} and no more: **only**.
Someone who buys with {0|shell} money and {1|turns, 反 fǎn} the goods round to sell: a **vendor**.
entries.plain: Someone who buys goods to sell them on: a vendor.

more.text: 反 fǎn, to turn over, gives the sound. Turning the goods round is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Metal} goods going out the door, each much {1|like, 肖 xiào} the last, until none is left: **to sell**.
entries.plain: Goods going out the door until none is left: to sell.

more.text: 肖 xiào, to be like, gives the sound. The goods all alike are only a memory trick.
It also means to melt metal.

entries.hook: A kind {1|heart} giving a little extra: a **favour**.
A {0|hand} reaches past green berries and takes the red one: **to pick**.

more.text: Choosing the red berry is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|person} everyone finds pleasing: **fine**.
A {0|mouth} calling across the {1|sea, 海 hǎi}: **hi**.
entries.plain: A mouth calling out a greeting: hi.

more.text: 海 hǎi, sea, gives the sound. Calling across the sea is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: The {0|flesh} that {1|wraps, 包 bāo} a baby before birth: the **womb**.
entries.plain: The flesh around a baby before birth: the womb.

more.text: 包 bāo, to wrap, gives the sound. The wrapping is only a memory trick.
In 雙胞胎, twins, it is two from one womb.

entries.hook: A baby growing in the {0|flesh}, on its own small {1|platform, 台 tái}: an **unborn baby**.
entries.plain: A baby growing inside the body: an unborn baby.

more.text: 台 tái, platform, gives the sound. The small platform is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Everyone {1|together, 共 gòng}, with a full {0|heart}: **respectful**.
entries.plain: A full heart, bowing: respectful.

more.text: 共 gòng, together, gives the sound. Everyone together is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A child sitting still with hands folded: **well-behaved**.

more.text: The classic dictionary reads it as horns pointing apart, with the old meaning "to go against". The sitting child is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: An older {0|woman} of the family: an **older woman**.

more.text: 婆婆 is a husband's mother.

entries.hook: A {0|tree} whose fruit is cut with a {1|sharp, 利 lì} knife: a **pear**.
entries.plain: A tree with sweet, juicy fruit: a pear.

more.text: 利 lì, sharp, gives the sound. The sharp knife is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A loud {0|yawn} interrupts your friend's story, and you cover your mouth, feeling **sorry**.

more.text: The yawn you could not hold back is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|person with a strange head}: **different**.

more.text: It looks like 田 field over 共 today, but it is one drawing.

entries.hook: You are {0|going} around a puddle, keeping your shoes dry: **to avoid**.

more.text: Walking around the puddle is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: The last of the {0|thread}, as {1|winter, 冬 dōng} is the last of the year: **the end**.
entries.plain: The last of the thread: the end.

more.text: 冬 dōng, winter, gives the sound. Winter as the last of the year is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|crow} sitting right there on the branch: **at**.

more.text: The drawing is a crow. "At" only borrowed its sound, so the crow on its branch is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A paste left in the {0|wine jar} that {1|will, 將 jiāng} be ready in time: a **sauce**.
entries.plain: A paste left in a jar until it is ready: a sauce.

more.text: 將 jiāng, will, gives the sound. "Will be ready" is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: What is left in the {0|wine jar} when the wine turns sour: **vinegar**.
A {0|tree} in a {1|peaceful, 寧 níng} garden, heavy with sour yellow fruit: **lemon**.
entries.plain: A tree heavy with sour yellow fruit: lemon.

more.text: 寧 níng, peaceful, gives the sound. The peaceful garden is only a memory trick.
It makes the first half of 檸檬, lemon.

entries.hook: The {0|tree} with the sour yellow fruit: **lemon**.

more.text: It makes the second half of 檸檬, lemon.

entries.hook: A {0|person} who stands out from the crowd: **handsome**.
Standing at the {0|door}, looking over each one that passes: **to read through**.
A {0|hand} pulling one out {1|from, 由} the pile: **to draw out**.

more.text: 由 yóu, from, was the sound long ago. Pulling it from the pile is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {1|thought, 意 yì} the {0|heart} keeps: **to remember**.
entries.plain: What the heart keeps: to remember.

more.text: 意 yì, thought, gives the sound. The thought the heart keeps is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Putting {0|food} into a waiting mouth: **to feed**.
A {1|measuring hand} holding out an offering to the {0|chief}: **to honour**.
A {1|child} holding up the {0|old}: **devoted to parents**.
Thunder in the {0|rain} that makes everything tremble: **to shake**.
The great {0|wind} that hits {1|Taiwan, 台 tái} in summer: **typhoon**.
entries.plain: The great wind that comes off the sea in summer: typhoon.

more.text: 台 tái, short for Taiwan, gives the sound. The wind hitting Taiwan is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Fire} running down a whole {1|row, 列 liè} of houses: **fierce**.
entries.plain: Fire burning hard and fast: fierce.

more.text: 列 liè, a row, gives the sound. The row of houses is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {1|dog} bursting out of a {0|cave}: **sudden**.
A {0|carved piece of jade}, worked all the way round: **all around**.

more.text: The drawing is carved jade, now written 琱. "Around" only borrowed its sound, so "worked all the way round" is only a memory trick.
The 口 was added later as a mark and has no meaning here.

entries.hook: {0|Walls} closing in on every side: **to surround**.
A {0|tree} in one drawing: **tree, wood**.
{0|Water} climbs the stairs and floats your slippers out the door: **to flood**.

more.text: The slippers floating away is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|bug} that carries loads like a tiny {1|horse, 馬 mǎ}: **ant**.
entries.plain: A bug that carries loads many times its size: ant.

more.text: 馬 mǎ, horse, gives the sound. The tiny horse is only a memory trick.
It makes the first half of 螞蟻, ant.

entries.hook: A {0|bug} that does what is {1|right, 義 yì} for the whole nest: an **ant**.
entries.plain: A bug that works for the whole nest: an ant.

more.text: 義 yì, what is right, gives the sound. Doing right by the nest is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Loud {0|chatter} that nobody {1|dares, 敢} answer back: **severe**.

more.text: 敢 gǎn, to dare, was the sound long ago. Nobody daring to answer is only a memory trick.
It first meant to boast, then extreme and severe.

entries.hook: The very top of the {0|head}: the **top**.
{0|Rice} gone soft and sour at the bottom of the pot: **spoiled**.

more.text: The rice gone sour is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|hand} throwing seed wide over the field: **to spread**.
{0|Streams} in flood above and {1|fire} below: **disaster**.

more.text: Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

entries.hook: {0|Earth} crumbles under a chair, sending it into a hole: **to collapse**.

more.text: The chair falling into a hole is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: How many steps of the {0|foot} from here to there: **distance**.
The stuff a small {0|bug}, the bee, builds its comb with: **wax**.
A small {0|fire} on a stick of wax: a **candle**.
A {0|hand} reaching into the {1|storehouse, 倉 cāng}: **to rob**.
entries.plain: A hand grabbing what is not its own: to rob.

more.text: 倉 cāng, storehouse, gives the sound. The storehouse is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|mountain} in the sea where only a {1|bird, 鳥 niǎo} can land: an **island**.
entries.plain: A mountain standing in the sea: an island.

more.text: 鳥 niǎo, bird, gives the sound. The bird landing is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|net} set up {1|straight, 直 zhí} in its spot: **to place**.
entries.plain: A net set up in its spot: to place.

more.text: 直 zhí, straight, gives the sound. Setting it straight is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: What everyone can {0|see} and must follow: a **rule**.

more.text: References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.

entries.hook: Something {0|sweet}, and then far too much of it: **extremely**.

more.text: Nobody is sure how this character began. "Too much sweet" is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: An {0|arrow reaching the ground}: **to arrive**.

more.text: In 甚至 it is "as far as": even.

entries.hook: {1|Carts} drawn up under one {0|cover}: an **army**.

more.text: References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.

entries.hook: Counting up all that a {0|village} has: an **amount**.

more.text: References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.

entries.hook: A {0|hand} raised to send the {1|army, 軍} forward: **to wave**.

more.text: 軍 jūn, army, was the sound long ago. Sending the army forward is only a memory trick.
In 發揮 it is bringing your abilities out into play.

pieces.name: footstep
pieces.note: now looks like 夂 trailing foot

entries.hook: One {1|footstep} and then another {2|footstep} coming down the {0|hill}: **to come down**.
A {1|thing falling} out of the {0|hand}: **to lose**.

more.text: Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

entries.hook: The {1|moon} showing through a gap in the {0|door}, and nothing you must do: **free time**.

more.text: Nothing you must do is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A patch sewn onto {0|clothing}: **to mend**.

more.text: In 補習 it is making up lessons: extra classes.

entries.hook: Too young for the {0|toil} and the {1|heavy, 重 zhòng} loads: a **child**.
entries.plain: Too young for hard work: a child.

more.text: 重 zhòng, heavy, gives the sound. The heavy loads are only a memory trick.
It first meant a young servant boy.
Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

entries.hook: A {0|foot} stepping from one thing on to the next: **of**.

more.text: The drawing is a foot. Stepping from one thing to the next is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|horse} rearing up, and you keep a {1|respectful, 敬 jìng} distance: **startled**.
entries.plain: A horse rearing up: startled.

more.text: 敬 jìng, to respect, gives the sound. The respectful distance is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Words} stuck behind your {1|teeth, 牙 yá}, mouth open: **amazed**.
entries.plain: No words come, mouth open: amazed.

more.text: 牙 yá, tooth, gives the sound. Words stuck behind the teeth are only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Water} on the floor and off you go: **to slide**.
The point of a {0|knife} going in: **to stab**.

more.text: In 刺激 it is a sharp push to the senses: exciting.

entries.hook: After running upstairs, you wipe salty {0|water} from your forehead: **sweat**.

more.text: Running upstairs and wiping the forehead is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Where the {0|water} runs so thin it is {1|hard, 難 nán} to float a boat: a **beach**.
entries.plain: Where the water runs thin over sand: a beach.

more.text: 難 nán, hard, gives the sound. The boat that is hard to float is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Something {0|tasty}, and you {1|still, 尚 shàng} want one more bite: **to taste**.
entries.plain: Something tasty on the tongue: to taste.

more.text: 尚 shàng, still, gives the sound. Wanting one more bite is only a memory trick.
In 嘗試 it is to try something out.

entries.hook: A {0|hill} that closes the road like the end of a {1|chapter, 章 zhāng}: a **barrier**.
entries.plain: A hill across the road: a barrier.

more.text: 章 zhāng, chapter, gives the sound. The end of a chapter is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|stone} lying in the road: **in the way**.
Something {1|heavy, 重 zhòng} flying across the {0|crossroads}: **to rush**.
entries.plain: Flying straight across the crossroads: to rush.

more.text: 重 zhòng, heavy, gives the sound. The heavy thing is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Water} rising in a {1|good, 良 liáng} high curl: a **wave**.
entries.plain: Water rising in a high curl: a wave.

more.text: 良 liáng, good, gives the sound. The good curl is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Drink from the {0|wine jar} so strong it wakes you up: **cool**.

more.text: Its older meanings are strong and ruthless.
In this lesson it is the modern word for cool.
The drink that wakes you up is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A helping {1|right hand} in the family, father's younger brother: **uncle**.

more.text: Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.
The helping hand in the family is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: The {0|woman} who is your mother's sister: **aunt**.
A {1|mouth full of teeth} that bite and {0|stop, 止 zhǐ} the food: **teeth**.
entries.plain: A mouth full of teeth: teeth.

more.text: 止 zhǐ, to stop, was added later for the sound. Stopping the food is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|drop of blood} falling into a {1|dish}: **blood**.
**Since** the {0|bowl of grain} is already empty, the meal is over.

more.text: Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

entries.hook: A {0|cow} chosen as the {1|offering animal}: a **sacrifice**.

more.text: Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

entries.hook: A {0|cow} still {1|alive, 生 shēng}, kept for the offering: a **farm animal**.
entries.plain: A cow kept for the offering: a farm animal.

more.text: 生 shēng, alive, gives the sound. The cow still alive is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A tip of {0|grain} as {1|little, 少} as can be: a **second**.

more.text: 少 shǎo, little, was the sound long ago. "As little as can be" is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|mouth} adding to the {1|clamour}: **noise**.
You hug the {0|wine jar} and try to pour another cup into your shoe: **drunk**.

more.text: Pouring wine into a shoe is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|sprout} as bad as a {1|wicked person}: **poison**.
A {0|hand} snaps shut around a falling apple: **to catch**.

more.text: Catching the falling apple is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: You lower a {0|metal} hook into the pond and wait for a bite: **to fish**.

more.text: Lowering the hook into the pond is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|hand} taking fruit off the branch: **to pick**.
Young {0|grain} and a young {1|child}, each in its time of year: a **season**.

more.text: It first meant young.
References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.
Each in its time of year is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A ribbon of grey curls from the {0|fire} and makes you cough: **smoke**.

more.text: The grey ribbon making you cough is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Leaves dropping off the {0|plants}: **to fall**.

more.text: In 部落格, blog, it is used only for its sound.

entries.hook: A {0|child}, drawn upside down, growing on {1|walking legs} until it is full size: **to fill**.

more.text: One reading: a newborn and a standing person, a child growing up. The old dictionary Shuowen reads the top as a shortened sound piece. The child growing to full size is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|dog} sits beside one empty food bowl while all the others play outside: **alone**.

more.text: The dog beside the empty bowl is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Words} that count every single {1|sheep, 羊}: **detailed**.

more.text: 羊 yáng, sheep, was the sound long ago. Counting sheep is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|dog} sniffs your closed fists, then taps one with its paw: **to guess**.

more.text: The dog choosing a closed fist is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A drawing of an {0|elephant}: an **elephant**.

more.text: It also means the look of a thing. 氣象 is how the air looks: the weather.

entries.hook: Using your {0|head} before it happens: **in advance**.
You sit on a chair covered in {0|water} and stand up with your trousers **wet**.

more.text: 溼 is another way to write it.
Sitting on the wet chair is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Words} sent quickly from far away: a **message**.
A {0|bow} and another {1|bow}, both marked as worn out: **weak**.

entries.plain: Knowing, and using it well: wisdom.

more.text: 知 zhī, to know, gives the meaning and the sound.
The bottom was once 甘, added to an older drawing.

entries.hook: A {0|heart} that sees clearly: **intelligent**.

entries.gloss: to hold together, to keep up
entries.hook: A loop of {0|thread} keeps your broken glasses in one piece: **to hold together**.

more.text: The thread holding broken glasses is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|horse} with its head held high: **proud**.
A {0|person} lifts their nose and walks past your offered seat: **haughty**.

more.text: Walking past the offered seat is only a memory trick.

entries.gloss: to store up; 積極 = active
entries.hook: {0|Grain} stored up, sack on sack: **to store up**.

more.text: 積極 as a whole means active, keen.

entries.hook: The look of a {0|dog}, calm or angry: a **state**.

pieces.name: right hand
pieces.note: now looks like 爫 reaching hand

entries.hook: One {0|right hand} and another {1|right hand} pulling at the {2|thing fought over}: **to fight over**.
The {0|sun} gone, and you find your way by {1|sound, 音}: **dark**.

more.text: 音 yīn, sound, was the sound piece long ago. Finding your way by sound is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A way cut straight through the {0|hill}: a **tunnel**.
A {0|right hand} and a {3|measuring hand} stretched out along a {1|mat}, feeling for its length: **to search**.

more.text: The drawing shows two hands measuring an arm span. Feeling for the length is only a memory trick for "to search".

pieces.name: pieces of jade on a string

entries.hook: {0|Pieces of jade on a string}: **jade**.

more.text: A dot was added later to tell it from 王, king.
玉米, jade rice, is corn.

entries.hook: Bowing the {0|head} over the bowl, one sitting: the **counting word for meals**.

more.text: It also means to pause.
Bowing over the bowl is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: Going to someone's {1|place, 方 fāng} with {0|words} to ask: **to visit**.
entries.plain: Going to someone with questions: to visit.

more.text: 方 fāng, place, gives the sound. Going to their place is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: {0|Grain} heavy in the ear, standing firm in the wind: **steady**.
A piece of {0|earth} with its borders: a **region**.
A {0|hand with a stick} smashing the {1|shell, 貝 bèi}: **ruined**.
entries.plain: Something smashed with a stick: ruined.

more.text: 貝 bèi, shell, gives the sound. The smashed shell is only a memory trick.
In 腐敗 it is going bad: rotten.
References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.

entries.hook: A {0|hand} sends a ball into a waiting basket: **to throw**.

more.text: In 投資 it is throwing money in: to invest.
References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.
Throwing the ball into the basket is only a memory trick.

entries.hook: A {0|mouth facing down} above a {1|kneeling person}, and what it says must happen: **to cause**.

more.text: It also means an order.

entries.hook: A {0|person} standing where they stood before: **still**.
Walking the {0|road} with a {1|straight} {2|heart}: **virtue**.
The {0|sun} shining on all, {1|side by side, 並}: **everywhere**.

more.text: 並 bìng, side by side, was the sound long ago. Everyone side by side is only a memory trick.
References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.
